chunks.heading: Phone interpreters
chunks.text: Interpreter services are free for every member in any language. Conference the interpreter vendor line into the call and confirm the member's preferred language in CRM.
chunks.embedText: Interpreter and TTY Services | Phone interpreters | Interpreter services are free for every member in any language. Conference the interpreter vendor line into the call and confirm the member's preferred language in CRM.

chunks.heading: TTY and relay
chunks.text: Members who are deaf or hard of hearing can reach us through the 711 relay service. Agents should allow extra time and never hang up on a relay call.
chunks.embedText: Interpreter and TTY Services | TTY and relay | Members who are deaf or hard of hearing can reach us through the 711 relay service. Agents should allow extra time and never hang up on a relay call.

chunks.heading: Interpreters at appointments
chunks.text: Members can request a face-to-face or sign language interpreter for a medical appointment. Requests should be made at least 5 business days before the appointment.
